parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Comma-separated filters, all must match: 'commands' (n_commands > 0), 'downloads' (n_downloads > 0), 'success' (auth_success), 'tcpip' (n_tcpip > 0), 'none' (interest = 0, did nothing at all - mutually exclusive with the others).
